CLINICAL FEATURES OF ANAEMIAS
Clinical Features
Depends on the degree of anaemia, severity of the causative disorder and age of
the patient
The clinical effects of anaemia are due to anaemia itself and the disorder(s)
causing it.
- Common:
- Tiredness, lassitude, weakness, dyspnoea on exertion, palpitations,
pallor
- Less common:
- Angina of effort, faintness, giddiness, headache, ringing in the ears,
high output state congestive cardiac failure.
Differential Diagnoses
- Cardiac failure
- Respiratory failure
Complications
- Cardiac failure
